meta.title: Flagged for review
meta.intro: Items that could not be confirmed, or where sources disagree or look irregular. They do not block publication. Unverified table cells are also listed automatically on this page at build time.

irregularities.detail: No subway appears on the official RTC or Las Vegas Monorail sites read. The bus and Monorail are the only transit modes found on official sites.

irregularities.item: Feldman's Deli listed as a Las Vegas Bib Gourmand in a third-party reprint
irregularities.detail: The MICHELIN press release lists Feldman's Deli at 2005 E. 2700 S., Salt Lake City, UT. The Las Vegas Bib Gourmands are China Poblano, Esther's Kitchen and YEN Viet Kitchen. Resolved in favour of the official release.

irregularities.item: Monte listed in some Las Vegas roundups
irregularities.detail: Monte is a one-star MICHELIN restaurant in South Salt Lake, Utah. It is excluded from the Las Vegas count.

irregularities.item: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon: Monday hours
irregularities.detail: The official L'Atelier page lists Monday 5:00-9:30 PM open. The sister restaurant on the same property (Restaurant de Joël Robuchon) is closed Monday. Confirm before booking.
The official Caesars page shows 'Closed / Closed / Opens 5:00 PM' without a full weekly schedule. Hours left blank.

irregularities.item: Hoover Dam ticket button shows two different states
irregularities.detail: One read of the official Hoover Dam page showed the tour ticket button as 'not currently available'; a later read showed a live ticket link and prices. Check ticket availability on the official ticket page before planning.

irregularities.item: Hoover Dam visitor center hours exception text was cut off
irregularities.detail: The official page reads 'Open Daily 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (except Th...' and the text was truncated when read. Confirm the exception on the official page.

irregularities.item: RTC schedules are 'current as of August 23, 2026'
irregularities.detail: RTC notes a $118.5 million annual shortfall and F1 construction changes on the Strip. Schedules for Feb 2027 are not confirmed.

irregularities.item: Michelin press release date vs. ceremony date
irregularities.detail: The michelin.com release page is dated 31 Aug 2026; a Michelin North America post is dated Aug 26, 2026 and says the ceremony was on Aug 26 at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. Award content is the same in both; the date difference is noted only.

irregularities.item: Presidents' Day falls on the first preferred travel day
irregularities.detail: OPM lists Monday Feb 15, 2027 as Washington's Birthday (federal holiday). Effect on hotel prices is not verified.

irregularities.item: Red Rock Canyon requires timed-entry reservations in the trip window
irregularities.detail: Reservations are required Oct 1 to May 31, 8 AM to 5 PM, through Recreation.gov. This applies to Feb 15 to 18, 2027.

irregularities.item: Official pages that did not load through the fetch tool
irregularities.detail: guide.michelin.com (Las Vegas restaurant list); Venetian /hotel/rooms.html; Bellagio /hotel/rooms.html; and the Bellagio fountains page did not load through the fetch tool. Data from these pages is not used.

irregularities.item: Activity 'drive time from hotel' is blank for all activities
irregularities.detail: No official travel-time source was read. The 1-hour requirement cannot be confirmed yet.
Official page warns that Uber or Lyft may not return visitors from the park, which can strand them.

irregularities.item: Neon Museum: higher price for early or late admission from Jan 1, 2027
irregularities.detail: Official FAQ says arriving earlier or later than the selected ticket time may cost more starting January 1, 2027.

Restaurant venue links (e.g. Anima by Edo, Bouchon, Kabuto, Esther's Kitchen, YEN Viet Kitchen) come from the official Visit Las Vegas MICHELIN page. Each venue page was not opened this session, so the link is not separately verified. The sandbox has no general outbound web access, so an automated link check could not run here; scripts/linkcheck.mjs runs in CI.

irregularities.item: Michelin North America post read only from search results
irregularities.detail: The michelinmedia.com post (used only for the ceremony date in F9) was read as a search result, not as a full page fetch.
